# Create Art with ME

> A comprehensive resource for downloadable art lesson plans, worksheets, and educational materials covering drawing techniques, painting, color theory, and various art media.

Create Art with ME provides teachers and art educators with PDF-based instructional materials and worksheets designed to teach fundamental art techniques and concepts. The site specializes in structured lesson plans that cover both foundational art elements (like color theory and value) and specific medium-based techniques (drawing, painting, pastels, charcoal, and color pencils).

## Key Topics

- Color Theory
- Drawing Techniques
- Color Pencil Lessons
- Painting Techniques
- Art Elements & Principles
- Lesson Plans
- Worksheets
- Value & Shading
- Color Schemes
- Pastels & Charcoal
- Watercolor
- Art Education
- PDF Resources
- Teaching Materials
- Instructional Bundles

## Drawing Techniques

- [Drawing Lessons & Worksheets PDF Archives](https://createartwithme.com/product-category/lesson-plans-worksheets/art-technique-lesson-plans-and-worksheets/drawing-lessons-worksheets-pdf): Drawing lessons covering hatching, shading, and value techniques with worksheets

## Color Theory & Color Schemes

- [Color Theory Lessons & Worksheets PDF Archives](https://createartwithme.com/product-category/lesson-plans-worksheets/art-elements-or-principles-based-lesson-plans-and-worksheets/color-theory-lessons-worksheets-pdf): Color theory lesson plans and worksheets covering schemes, mixing, and art elements

## Painting & Medium-Specific Techniques

- [Painting Lessons & Worksheets PDF Archives](https://createartwithme.com/product-category/lesson-plans-worksheets/art-technique-lesson-plans-and-worksheets/painting-lessons-worksheets-pdf): Painting technique lessons for watercolor, oil, tempera, and color pencil
- [Color Pencil Lessons & Worksheets PDF Archives](https://createartwithme.com/product-category/lesson-plans-worksheets/art-technique-lesson-plans-and-worksheets/color-pencil-technique-lessons-worksheets-pdf): Color pencil drawing techniques lesson plans and worksheets with bundles
- [Pastels & Charcoal Lessons & Worksheets PDF Archives](https://createartwithme.com/product-category/lesson-plans-worksheets/art-technique-lesson-plans-and-worksheets/pastels-charcoal-lessons-worksheets-pdf): Pastel and charcoal drawing techniques lesson plans and worksheets bundles
